mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional triggering conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20-day SPX returns is less than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annualized triggers central bank tightening expectations, pressuring equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) or Rank IC between CPIAUCSL YoY change and 5-day SPX returns is greater than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer credit (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust household demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through strengthened corporate revenue expectations.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS and HOUST both increase > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered periods (RSAFS and HOUST both >0.5% MoM) or Rank IC for the interaction signal is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), tight labor markets fuel wage growth and corporate profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% or Rank IC between UNRATE and 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 or Rank IC between INDPRO and 5-day SPX returns is greater than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1300.0 thousand units signals reduced consumer confidence and weak economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1300.0 or Rank IC between HOUST and 20-day SPX returns is greater than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates broad economic slowdown, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods (INDPRO < 105.0 and UNRATE > 4.0%) or Rank IC for the interaction signal is greater than -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained high level of consumer credit (RSAFS) above 500,000 million dollars indicates strong household spending, supporting corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without triggering conditions.
failure_condition: Rank IC between RSAFS and 5-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
